- [2023/05/26] Termination can occur through mutual agreement or unilateral action, requiring proper notice and compliance with contract terms.

- [2023/05/26] The Appeal Panel in Blessed Sydney Constructions PL v Vasudevan ruled that renewal applications are not constrained by the Brewarrina principle.
- [2023/05/26] Types of orders available on renewal applications include rectification orders, money orders, and any order the Tribunal could have originally made.
- [2023/05/26] Electing to terminate a contract affects the types of orders available and allows for claims unconstrained by the Brewarrina principle.
